summary_en: ITG-G Holdings submitted a correction to its tender offer filing for Kadoya Sesame Mills on October 29, 2026, following earlier filings in September and October 2026.
title_en: Notice of Changes to the Announcement Regarding the Commencement of a Tender Offer for Ordinary Shares of Kadoya Sesame Mills Inc. in Connection with the Submission of Corrections to the Tender Offer Filing by ITG-G Holdings Inc.
translation_en_brief:
ITG-G Holdings submitted a correction to its tender offer filing for Kadoya Sesame Mills on October 29, 2026, pursuant to Articles 27-8(1) and (2) of the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act. This correction was filed with the Kanto Local Finance Bureau and resulted in changes to the announcement of the commencement of the tender offer that was originally announced on September 14, 2026.

The correction filing became necessary following earlier correction filings submitted on September 25, 2026 and October 8, 2026. The specific details of the changes made in the correction are indicated in the attached materials. This notice was published at the request of ITG-G Holdings pursuant to Article 30(1)(iv) of the Cabinet Office Ordinance on the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act.
